notes: The frozen 522 corpus is never edited. Multi-country synthetic tests are a separate population.
Both Prompt Guard 2 sizes are pending and fail closed. Pending blocks are not detection successes.
The Stage 7 necessary privacy gate uses nonempty pre-injection candidate coverage and independent planted-value scans, not the zero releases caused by pending injection protection.
Google native-only is a local comparison control and can never authorize a live send.
Quality uses local cloud-surrogate guidance and a matched local baseline. Actual cloud answer quality remains deferred.

priorAbortedRuns.note: Stopped before completion; retained outside the new run. No cached item or inference is reused across the changed source fingerprint.

metrics.label: Attacks blocked by the pipeline

metrics.label: Saved outputs blocked before local application

gate.reason: The 0/50 candidate condition requires fifty available nonempty questions and zero independently detected seed survivors.

network.scope: All retained invocations, including resumed local work

findings: The reviewed local Meta and Google stacks provide no dedicated open local PII redactor; prompted local model checks and Meta experimental PII detection are distinct from redaction.
The Google native local control includes no injection detector. Hosted Google Model Armor is outside this local-only comparison.
caveats: Context clues can still identify a person.
This is not a compliance claim.
Both injection models remain pending; operational blocks caused by their absence are not evidence of attack detection.
Cloud answer quality remains deferred; all quality measurements use local surrogate guidance and local application.
The frozen PII population is Australian-format data; the separate multi-country population is never pooled with it.
